unit.title: Reliable POSIX Process Supervision
unit.scope: Design, implement, test, and explain one small process supervisor that launches a command without a shell, captures its output, enforces a timeout, and reports termination correctly.

unit_completion_requires: all declared learner artifacts are present
the project builds from a clean submission using the documented command
automated checks exercise normal exit, nonzero exit, argument preservation, output separation, launch failure, and timeout behavior
an examiner-controlled review applies examiner_only/RUBRIC.md to the submitted evidence
completion_policy.course_completion_rule: Later course units may be added only after their source material and ordering are independently retrieved, classified, and validated; finishing this kickoff must never mark the approximately 150-hour catalog course complete.

catalog_facts_used: the course concerns advanced computer systems and program construction
the catalog names C/C++ and Unix fluency
the catalog emphasizes practical labs, testing, parallel work, and multi-machine systems
the catalog estimates the whole course at 150 human hours
